questions.prompt: According to WHO's Global Tuberculosis Report 2025, how many people worldwide died from tuberculosis in 2024 (including people with HIV)?
questions.insight: TB remains the world's leading cause of death from a single infectious agent.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's population lived on less than $8.30 a day in 2024? (World Bank poverty line typical of upper-middle-income countries, in 2021 international dollars adjusted for price differences, PPP.)
How many million tonnes of electronic waste (e-waste) were generated worldwide in 2022, according to the UN Global E-waste Monitor 2024?
questions.insight: E-waste generation is rising by about 2.6 million tonnes a year and is on track to reach 82 million tonnes by 2030.

questions.prompt: According to UNICEF, what share of young women aged 20 to 24 worldwide were married or in a union before their 18th birthday?
questions.insight: UNICEF estimates about 640 million girls and women alive today were married in childhood, down from 21% to 19% over five years.

questions.prompt: According to UNAIDS and WHO estimates, how many people worldwide were living with HIV at the end of 2025?
questions.insight: About 78% of all people living with HIV were accessing antiretroviral treatment at the end of 2025.
